entry.title: Proposed Amendments to the Banking Act Enforcement Regulation and Capital Adequacy Notices (public comment)
entry.summary: 「銀行法施行規則」等、「自己資本比率規制（第１の柱・第３の柱）に関する告示」等及び「主要行等向けの総合的な監督指針」等の一部改正（案）について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 18, 2026 · Draft / consultationThe Financial Services Agency published draft amendments to the Enforcement Regulation of the Banking Act, notices on capital adequacy regulation (Pillars 1 and 3), and the comprehensive supervisory guidelines for major banks, and opened a public comment period. The amendments would allow banks to consolidate subsidiary funds according to their equity stake and clarify the consolidation scope for leverage, liquidity and TLAC rules. The archived text and attachments run to about 52,427 characters; the summary is based only on the first 12,000. Check the original.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference (Nov. 17, 2026)
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年11月17日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Nov 18, 2026 · MeetingThis is a summary of the question-and-answer session at Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference on November 17, 2026. It covers the government's autumn Business Administration Review, which discussed four funds, and progress on fund reviews under Japan's DOGE-style initiative. The session also addresses reviews of tax special measures and expectations for discussion in the ruling party's Tax Commission.

entry.title: IOSCO statement warning of rising fraud targeting retail investor accounts at securities firms and other market intermediaries
entry.summary: 国際関係,証券監督者国際機構（IOSCO）による「市場仲介業者（証券会社等）の個人顧客を標的とした詐欺の増加に係る声明」について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 18, 2026 · GuidanceThe International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) published a statement on 16 November 2026 warning that fraud targeting retail investor accounts at market intermediaries is rising and becoming more sophisticated. It describes how fraudsters increasingly use AI, social engineering and digital channels, and common schemes such as impersonation, account takeover and identity theft. The statement shares practical lessons for intermediaries and investors but does not create new IOSCO standards. The archived text and attachments run to about 17,817 characters; the summary is based only on the first 12,000. entry.title: FSA recruits staff for financial monitoring on customer-focused business operations
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（金融モニタリング業務（顧客本位の業務運営実践状況等に係る分析・対話等業務）に従事する職員） 金融庁 · Nov 19, 2026 · PersonnelThe Financial Services Agency is recruiting one full-time national civil servant to monitor how financial businesses put customer-first business operations into practice. The role mainly involves analyzing firms' responses based on the Principles for Customer-Oriented Business Conduct. The post is based in Chiyoda, Tokyo, with an initial term of about two years, and selection is by document screening followed by an interview.

entry.title: FSA recruits a staff member for domestic financial system policy work (lawyers only)
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（国内金融に関する制度の企画及び立案等に従事する職員） 金融庁 · Nov 19, 2026 · PersonnelThe Financial Services Agency is hiring one assistant section chief-level staff member to plan and draft domestic financial system rules, including crypto-asset rules and standards, securities market regulations, and drafts for legislation and Diet materials. Applicants must be licensed attorneys with broad knowledge or experience in financial laws. The position is a fixed-term national civil service appointment, generally lasting one to two years.

entry.title: Announcement on promoting business support and facilitating finance
entry.summary: 事業者支援の促進及び金融の円滑化について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 19, 2026 · GuidanceOn November 19, 2026, the Financial Services Agency held a exchange of views between government officials and representatives of financial industry groups, and the government issued a request to those groups the same day. It asks financial institutions to ensure businesses' cash flow is not seriously disrupted ahead of the year-end and fiscal year-end, and to provide forward-looking management support that stays close to businesses.

entry.title: Selection of chair and vice-chair of IOSCO standing committees
entry.summary: 国際関係,IOSCO(証券監督者国際機構) 常設委員会議長・副議長選出について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 17, 2026Japan's Financial Services Agency announced that IOSCO selected Koichiro Kuramochi as chair of the Accounting, Disclosure and Auditing Committee and Yasumune Kano as vice-chair of the Wholesale Market Conduct and Intermediation Committee. Their terms are planned for two years from November 2026. IOSCO also released a new standing committee structure, effective 13 November 2026.

entry.title: Summary of Finance Minister Katayama's post-cabinet press conference (November 13, Reiwa 8)
entry.summary: 記者会見,片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要（令和８年11月13日）について掲載しました。 金融庁 · Nov 17, 2026 · SpeechAt a press conference after the cabinet meeting on November 13, 2026, Finance Minister Katayama announced that the cabinet approved using 651.9 billion yen from the Middle East situation response reserve fund. Of this, 521.9 billion yen covers utility bill relief from December to February, and 130 billion yen is for additional regional priority support grants. The conference also covered a 52 billion yen special allocation tax for a Kumamoto reconstruction fund, and answers on the consumption tax and support bill, defense spending, and the joint yen intervention with the United States.

entry.title: Recruitment notice for a Financial Services Agency staff member in AML/CFT monitoring work
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（金融モニタリング業務（マネー・ローンダリング・テロ資金供与対策）に従事する職員） 金融庁 · Nov 17, 2026 · PersonnelThe Financial Services Agency of Japan is recruiting a full-time public official for financial monitoring work on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing. The post is expected to be filled on a fixed-term basis of about two years, which may be renewed. Duties include preparing for the FATF's fifth mutual evaluation of Japan and coordinating with foreign authorities and ministries.

entry.title: FSA announces the Japan Fintech Week 2027 event schedule
entry.summary: イベント,「Japan Fintech Week 2027」の開催について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 17, 2026The Financial Services Agency and the Fintech Association of Japan will hold Japan Fintech Week 2027 from February 22 to March 5, 2027. The event aims to promote Japan's fintech appeal worldwide and create business opportunities. Related events across Japan will be linked so that domestic and overseas fintech participants can network as one event, and qualifying events may be listed on a dedicated website.

entry.title: FSA job opening: market and liquidity risk monitoring for deposit-taking institutions
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（金融モニタリング業務（各種リスク管理態勢）に従事する職員） 金融庁 · Oct 23, 2026 · PersonnelThe Financial Services Agency (FSA) is recruiting one staff member to monitor market and liquidity risk management at deposit-taking financial institutions. Duties include analysis and dialogue with major banks, planning horizontal monitoring of regional banks, and supporting bureau inspections. Applicants need over ten years of practical experience in risk management or market operations, and the position is a fixed-term full-time national civil servant role. The application deadline is November 6, 2026.

entry.title: Draft Cabinet Orders and Ordinances for the 2026 Amendments to the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act (Sustainability Disclosure and Assurance; Startup Financing)
entry.summary: 令和８年金融商品取引法等改正に係る政令・内閣府令案等（サステナビリティ情報の開示・保証、スタートアップ企業への資金供給の促進関係）について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 13, 2026 · Draft / consultationJapan's Financial Services Agency has published draft cabinet orders and ministerial ordinances implementing the 2026 amendments to the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. The drafts cover sustainability information disclosure and assurance, and measures to promote funding for startups. They set registration requirements for non-financial information audit firms, designate sustainability disclosure standards, and add safe-harbor rules for forward-looking information. The amendments are scheduled to take effect on April 1, 2027, and public comments are accepted until December 13, 2026. entry.title: Updated list of financial institutions' EMP initiatives (Japan's Emerging Manager Promotion Program)
entry.summary: その他,金融機関のEMPに係る取組事例一覧を更新しました。 金融庁 · Nov 16, 2026The FSA has updated its list of financial institutions' EMP (Emerging Manager Promotion Program, Japan's version) initiatives. The program stems from the government's asset management policy plan of December 2023, which asks banks and insurers to actively use emerging asset managers and not exclude them merely for having short track records. The list compiles initiatives from institutions that submitted the designated form, and institutions may submit new initiatives for listing.

entry.title: Update on major financial groups' efforts to strengthen asset management and governance
entry.summary: その他,大手金融機関グループ等の取組状況（運用力向上・ガバナンス強化等）について更新しました。 金融庁 · Nov 16, 2026 · GuidanceThe Financial Services Agency updated its list of major financial groups' efforts to improve asset management capabilities and strengthen governance. The list follows a December 2023 policy plan calling on these groups to publish plans for these goals. Financial firms wishing to be listed must post their plan on their website and submit a reporting form to the FSA.
